purpose: Exposed-data numerical recalibration; no physical preregistration or UD promotion
rule: For each coordinate select the largest fine h in the declared ladder below 0.9 times the nearest numerically located angular branch crossing. Coarse=2h, audit=h/2. Coarse may cross; retained fine and audit must not. Require both adjacent full-vector absolute and relative discrepancies below unchanged thresholds. No response-adaptive reselection; failure is HOLD.
guard: Polynomial roots for affine bonds and cosine knot, sign checked; numerical guard, not interval arithmetic proof. Other REBO branches not certified. Fixed-graph bond-length guard <1.7 Angstrom.
direction_rule: Three old sine regression vectors plus three previously unused cos(sqrt(2/3/5)*index) unit vectors. Fixed coarse/fine/audit steps 2.5e-5,1.25e-5,6.25e-6; all require adjacent absolute/relative stability and agreement with symmetrized retained H. No directional step reselection.
